name: Creator community platform
note: A creator community platform with communities, courses, chat, a feed and live streams, rebuilt after its first developer left. Automated creator payouts with a payout ledger and a referral system.

caseStudy.title: Payouts that stopped going missing.
caseStudy.context: A creator community with 1,000+ paying members, rebuilt after its first developer left with a half-built Stripe Connect integration.
caseStudy.problem: Payout state lived only in Stripe’s webhooks. One dropped webhook meant one missed creator payout. Money was coming in, but creators were not reliably paid.
caseStudy.decision: I moved payout state into the platform’s own database, with Stripe as the rail, not the record.

results.label: organic sign-ups from the referral system
missed payouts since the ledger shipped

approach.title: Audit
approach.text: Mapped every Stripe Connect event and traced where money and status got stuck.

approach.title: Webhooks
approach.text: A listener verifies every payout event. A failed transfer is flagged, retried with exponential backoff, and the ops team is told if it fails twice.

approach.title: Owned state
approach.text: The database owns onboarding and payout status; it is never inferred from Stripe at request time.

approach.title: Gated payouts
approach.text: Payouts fire only when an account is fully verified.

approach.title: Dunning
approach.text: Retry windows and email nudges for failed onboarding and failed subscription charges.
